terms.gloss: a way round, a roundabout way
evidence: Suet. Aug. 17: Asiae Syriaeque circuitū Aegyptum petit (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically any going round or roundabout route; Traupman uses it for a bypass. “By a roundabout way” is the ablative circuitū.

sources: Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 285.
